abort.external_url_unavailable: Home Assistant could not determine a secure HTTPS address used by this browser. Open Home Assistant through an HTTPS address reachable on your phone and try again.

error.invalid_code: The verification code is invalid or expired
error.auth_blocked: NETGEAR temporarily blocked this sign-in. Stop retrying and try again later.

password_login.description: Sign in with your NETGEAR account. NETGEAR may send a one-time verification code.

mobile_login.description: Open the one-time website while the phone can reach Home Assistant. Keep the tab open, turn off Wi-Fi or disconnect the VPN, and sign in using mobile data. If sending the result fails, reconnect to Wi-Fi or VPN and retry from the same tab. The link expires after 10 minutes.

mobile_finish.description: Home Assistant received the mobile sign-in and is completing the Meural token exchange. Submit to retry this final exchange if NETGEAR temporarily rejected it.

challenge.description: Enter the verification response for {challenge} sent to {destination}.
